scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by a self-contained combinatorial proof and reproducible exact finite checks. Previously established one-dimensional 2-deck nullspace and the published conjectured generating function are credited to Chrisnata et al.; no independent assessment or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed binary alphabet, exactly three ones, length-three scattered-subsequence count vectors. No conclusions for other weights, alphabets, or deck lengths; finite exhaustive checks are corroborative, not the infinite proof. Equivalence with unindexed literature cannot be ruled out.
title: A complete two-point classification of weight-three binary three-deck fibers
